channel.title: Shark Bites
channel.desc: This time on Shark Bites, Steve Backshall looks at a shark with sensational superpowers. The epaulette shark is a small shark that lives in shallow, tidal waters and it can do something extraordinary. Able to survive out of water for a long period of time, Steve heads into his Shark Lab to show just how they manage it.
